lesson: GPT plans semantic phases, identities and recovery. Local measured composite tools execute fine operations. Never count commanded motion as native success.
Accepted peg approach or insertion did not prove engagement; several external manual releases slipped. Repeated contour-stereo calls all failed in reviewed traces.
scope: Historical OLD tool-loop skill, not evidence about this new candidate.

lesson: Random layout: identify task targets by semantic shape/texture, exclude distractors, and use the SAME local operation baseline as the ordinary task. Never infer ordinary/random from visual absence of distractors.
Identify three mugs, each handle aperture and unoccupied rack pegs; preserve mug/peg assignment.
Pick the mug body/rim leaving its handle aperture free. Inspect current carried mug.
Use three fresh multiview handle/peg frame features for dock. Destination mate frame describes entry alignment; seat is at the actual hanging support, not the peg tip.
Local dock aligns, enters axially, advances to measured seat, releases and withdraws.
Inspect that handle remains supported and mug clears table; fallen mug is recovery, not completion.
Repeat all three; place/recover any held failures on visible support before final home.
scope: External aggregate includes rare success, but cached detailed notes did not establish a successful release recovery.

lesson: No measured finger-stop/force sensor or automatic object retention/containment certificate. Attachment transforms assume no slip. Three-feature docking and support placement are implemented but unvalidated in native tasks. No new arbitrary tabletop spacing, residual-error, protected-step or retry-count gates.
